text: The following diagrams show the initial approach and subsequent tactical manoeuvring of Coffee 51 Flight as it was transiting in the vicinity of the KAF on 17 Apr 02, between approximately 21:15Z and 21:28Z.

During the engagement phase, data frequency for altitude, speed, heading, pitch angle, roll angle, and position (relative to impact point) has been extracted from supplied materials with a sampling frequency of one iteration per second. This yields a reconstruction of very high positional fidelity.
